posts.title: Friday Squid Blogging: The Largest Squid Ever Filmed
posts.description: This is the story of the largest squid ever filmed, in December 2006 near Japan’s Ogasawara Islands. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.

posts.title: Opening a 400-Year-Old Cryptex
posts.description: Researchers used CT scanning technology to recover the code and open a 400-year-old cryptex padlock. You can buy a USB-drive cryptex .

posts.title: France Is Blaming Iran for the Fridge Cyberattack
posts.description: Interesting : U.S. intelligence agencies have recently reached a “low confidence” assessment that Iran was responsible for the attacks in France, according to three U.S. officials who spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive intelligence.
